## Why

B2's append-only forensic sweep (the `append_only_register.csv`)
recorded 46 rows still owed after SEED-06 restored the 53 GATE
DECISIONS rows: 42 `loss` + 4 `transition-unjustified`. History rewrote
them in place — cells, readouts, contract text, run-ledger sections,
PHASE LOG entries, BUILD_INDEX rows, event lines — instead of
appending. This row appends every one back: removed text returns
verbatim from `<sha>^` with source, sha256 and archive; unjustified
lead-token flips gain dated corrections plus real `obligation-event/1`
transitions; grandfathered readouts gain the guard sentence. Nothing is
re-decided and no protected line is removed.
